justifications.fit: the gate follows export.py's GateResult and issue-dict idiom, the accessors sit beside get_sn_staging_dir at settings.py:1394, and the only out-of-idiom line is the private cross-module import of _authority_payload_hash at export.py:1620.

justifications.scope_discipline: five of the nine changed files (imas_codex/settings.py:1397, imas_codex/cli/sn.py:4757, standard_names/AGENTS.md, release_bar.json, the refusals json) sit outside the six declared write paths, each implied by the goal and none widening the refusal set.
